warnings: This sheet is a multi-view page: engineering spec notes (left) + pile/footing plan (right). This file covers the plan view only; the notes view is หน้า17_view1_notes.json.

Every point on this 3x3 grid prints both a footing mark (F1 or F2) and a column mark (C1 or C2) together (e.g. 'F1 C1'). Following the established convention from this series (house 024/028), column marks are not duplicated as separate elements[] entries here — C1 coincides with every F1 position below, C2 with the single F2 position (grid B2). Full column rebar specs are in หน้า21_view2_schedule_column.json.

Only the main 3x3 grid shows footing/column markers on this sheet; the west appendage (carport/ซักล้าง, per S-02/หน้า18) has no footing here — consistent with its SN-01 note 'PILING AND FOUNDATION DESIGN SHALL BE DETERMINED... BASED ON ACTUAL SOIL BEARING CAPACITY' and the ground-floor plan's 'เสาวางบนคาน (+0.00)' annotation (a support post resting directly on a ground beam, no independent footing).
